description: Paid exact-action authority preflight for consequential agent tool calls. Binds subject, tool, operation, target, canonical parameters, authority lifetime, retries and postcondition requirements. Costs $0.25 USDC on Base.

action.description: Exact consequential action being considered before execution.

consequence.description: Consequence class of the requested action.

operation.description: Exact operation or method requested on the tool.

parameters.description: Canonical caller-supplied action parameters to bind into the authority decision.

id.description: Exact target identifier within that type.

tool.description: Tool or capability that would perform the action.

authority.description: Caller-provided authority envelope to compare against the requested action.

allow_retry.description: Whether a retry is explicitly permitted by the authority grant.

allowed_operations.description: Operations permitted by the authority grant.

allowed_targets.description: Targets permitted by the authority grant.

id.description: Allowed target identifier within that type.

allowed_tools.description: Tools permitted by the authority grant.

attestation_verified.description: Whether the caller asserts that an authority attestation was independently verified.

expected_parameters_hash.description: Optional expected digest of canonical action parameters.

expires_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 expiry of the authority grant.

human_confirmation_required.description: Whether the authority grant requires a human confirmation step.

human_confirmed.description: Whether the caller asserts that the required human confirmation was completed.

max_attempts.description: Maximum execution attempts permitted by the authority grant.

postcondition_required.description: Whether authoritative postcondition verification is required after execution.

subject_id.description: Subject identifier that the authority grant applies to.

execution.description: Retry and prior-outcome state for this logical operation.

idempotency_key.description: Optional stable idempotency key for the logical operation.

prior_outcome.description: Authoritative knowledge about any prior attempt outcome.

retry_authorized.description: Whether the caller explicitly authorizes this retry after reconciling prior outcome.

postcondition.description: Expected authoritative postcondition contract for the action.

authoritative_source.description: Provider or exact owner that can authoritatively confirm the postcondition.

type.description: Type of postcondition that must be verified after execution.

subject.description: Subject identity facts for the requested action.

id.description: Stable identifier for the agent or subject requesting the action.

identity_verified.description: Whether the caller asserts that the subject identity was verified.

name: verify_agent_action_intent
title: Verify Agent Action Intent
